text:
Bea (Marketing): short brief 1 launch next Wed 1 need a small 'benchmark mosaic' visual kit: hero/email banner + webinar overlay frames + a 1:1 social gif. focus: credible data story, compact assets for ads + registration page.
Omar (Design): ok. what's in-scope exactly?
Bea (Marketing): deliverables: 1) email/hero banner 1200x600 2) webinar overlay frame 1920x1080 (title-safe 140px, 200px CTA-safe) 3) social gif 1:1 (1080x1080, ~3s loop, CTA pulse) 4) figma slide template 16:9 with editable metric pills. Also need logo-left and centered variants.
Lin (Creative Ops): add figma source, export tokens, and EN/FR/ES copy placeholders. L10n note: allow +25% width for DE. Tagging legal for any benchmark numbers.
ExportBot: export checklist added: PNG @2x, SVG icon set, GIF optimized (gifsicle --optimize=3 --colors 128). Accessibility: contrast ratio >=4.5:1; include alt text.
Gabe (Growth): CTAs for A/B testing: "View benchmark" and "Reserve a seat". Need two caption options for social and one short tagline for the email hero (max 60 chars). Also request an animated sparkline reveal in the gif.
Omar (Design): style call 1 data-led mosaic: stacked metric tiles + single small mascot accent. would you rather a single large metric or a 3-metric carousel?
Bea (Marketing): prefer 3-metric carousel for credibility (cost, latency, throughput). keep mascot very subtle.
Pri (Legal): flagged 1 any absolute claims must reference bench-run-0624 and include a 12px methodology footnote. If values are preliminary, use relative language ("up to" or "typical").
Omar (Design): timeline: initial mock Thu EOD, review Fri, final assets Mon AM. will include both logo lockups and provide Figma link when WIP ready.
Lin (Creative Ops): export snippet to include in figma file:
```
PNG: 2x export
SVG: outline strokes
GIF: gifsicle --optimize=3 --colors 128
```
Gabe (Growth): social gif spec: 3-frame loop, 12fps, max 600kb for ad. add small CTA pulse on frame 2. Provide alt text and microcopy for caption variants.
Omar (Design): noted. I'll also include a dark-mode color set and a high-contrast CTA fallback.
Bea (Marketing): great. I'll schedule an expedited review Fri 10am PST. Ping here if legal or L10n need changes. Thanks :thumbsup:
